notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.4
notes.content:
HELL(o)!

We are back with some cool new changes! We have added a Tutorial in the Main menu, improved the gameplay balance and did some minor bugfixing! As always, full list of changes is listed below. 


Patch Notes v.1.0.4 :



User friendly changes & optimization:
[list]
[*] We added a Tutorial! Now you will have a better explanation of what to do in the Void.
[/list]


Game Balance: 
[list]
[*] Locusts are now slower in late game 
[*] Score points for destroying an obelisk got increased from 350 to 650 points 
[*] Crystals now give you 75 points 
[*] Fountain will charge 10% slower than before
[*] Character damage was increased by 10% for the first power level
[*] Character damage was increased by 40% for the second power level
[*] Character speed after the first upgrade was changed from 5% to 7%
[*] Character speed after the second upgrade was changed from 10% to 12% 
[*] Player know will get knocked back after getting hit
[*] Number of enemies in late stages was decreased 
[*] Number of laser turrets on the arena was increased
[*] Gap between game stages was increased
[/list]

BugFix:
[list]
[*] Fixed collisions on Fountain and Obelisks
[*] Fixed a rare issue with achievement "Swarm destroyer"
[*] Fixed "Unlimited Power" achievment
[*] Fixed a bug with footsteps sound after game launch

[/list]

Special thanks for the user Genebris for letting us know of some of the issues.

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]Hi Again! [/b]
This time we have much smaller update but we think that it will bring a lot to a gameplay. 
without further ado details are listed below:


[olist]
[*] The Void shimmers now with blue light! It means that it will be easier to separate arena from the void during a jump
[*] Locust bug fix - Now locust don't stuck in objects such as obelisk
[*] Best Run rework -"Best Run" stats will show you your stats that you achieved during your record run!

[/olist]

[b]Have fun in Void![/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]HELL(o)![/b]

Let us present you so called "[i]a day one patch[/i]". We've made some smaller bugfixes, user friendly changes and [u][b]a lot of game balance modifications[/b][/u]. Now the pace should be smoother and you will be able to score [b][u]much higher[/u][/b] in leaderboard! Details are listed below. 

[i][b]Have fun in void![/b][/i]

[b]Patch Notes v.1.0.2 :[/b] 

[b]User friendly changes & optimization:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Logos sequence after game launch is now skippable.
[*] Ambient noise volume in game is now quieter.
[*] Leaderboard now refresh every time when you enter them in main menu.
[*] Player damage effect is now more optimized that means more fps when you get hit by an enemy. 
[*] All sounds in game are now more balanced relative to each other. 
[*] Apophis now make sounds! 
[*] Rippers now are reacting to dmg, they slow down and change colors.
[*] Added more hints on game start. 
[/list]

[b]BugFix:[/b]

[list]
[*]  Fixed an issue with leaderboard ranking icon display. 
[*]  Fixed rare bug when tile could break under the apophis. 
[*]  Now volume of footsteps sound can be adjusted.
[*]  Fixed misspelled achievement description
[*]  Fixed Upgrade slow motion bug. Now you should get slow motion effect only during the beam upgrade.
[*]  Fixed "Jumper!" Achievement now you can unlock it
[*]  Fixed Achievements unlock : "Free Fall" and "Don't Give Up"
[*]  Some minor tweaks. 
[/list]

[b]Game Balance: [/b]
[list]
[*]  Using fountain does not decrease your power level.
[*]  Adjusting difficulty spike, now it's more fluid and fair
[*]  Power upgrades now are speeding up the player.
[*]  Slow effect after receiving dmg is change from 10% to 4%
[*]  Turrets range was decreased by 25%
[*]  Turrets rotation was decreased by 28%
[*]  Delay between obelisk show up was reduced .
[*]  Number of maximum obelisks on level was decreased in late phase of the game.
[*]  Time between AI spawn from obelisk was reduced in late phase of the game.
[*]  Fountain Scarab has now 75 hp instead of 1hp so no more miss fountain activation.
[*]  Ripper AI hit points was reduced from 75hp to 50hp.
[*]  Shooter spiders hit points was reduced from 75hp to 40 hp.
[*]  Locust are now turning slower in early phase of the game. 
[/list]
